title: Attribution Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating quote attribution accuracy and author suppression (selective omission) rates across a fame-balanced benchmark dataset featuring White, Black, Asian, and Latino authors under different prompting and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) settings.
Comparing quote attribution accuracy and author suppression rates between male and female authors using a demographically-balanced and fame-controlled quote attribution benchmark.

Measuring disparities in LLM quote attribution and selective omission (suppression) across intersectional demographic subgroups (White male, White female, Black male, Black female) while explicitly controlling for author fame (measured by search hits).
